name: Friday Night at the ER®
description: Commercial hospital systems-thinking board game endorsed by Peter Senge. Simulates the complex emergent dynamics of hospital operations. Used in healthcare management education to demonstrate how local optimization decisions create system-wide problems.
evaluation_method: patient wait times, hospital performance metrics, system-level outcomes
general_score_metric: composite_hospital_performance_metric (e.g., system-level outcomes such as average patient wait time, treatment completion rate)
notes: Endorsed by Peter Senge. Used in healthcare management education at universities and hospitals worldwide.
